title: Reservation Rule Completeness & Verification Contract
mandatoryElements: Vertical category quota mapping (UR, SC, ST, OBC_NCL, EWS)
Open-merit policy contract (verifying whether UR seats are open to all or restricted)
OBC Creamy Layer (OBC_CL) policy (strictly unreserved by default)
Post / stream / subject quota cross-tabulation dimensions
inferencePolicy: Personalized reservation engine is strictly barred from inferring unextracted reservation rules. If reservation policies are not audited, vacancy applicability returns VACANCIES_PENDING_RESERVATION_DATA.
